stalls.en: Zhong Ji Original Shanghai Pan-fried Buns
stalls.summaryZh: 只賣生煎包，底部煎得金黃酥脆，鮮肉餡多汁、高麗菜餡清脆，價格親民；什麼時段都在排隊，常有人一次買十幾顆。週三公休，賣完就收。米其林必比登推薦。
stalls.summaryEn: Sells only pan-fried buns, with golden, crisp bottoms. The pork filling is juicy and the cabbage filling crunchy, at a low price. There is a line at all hours, and people often buy a dozen or more. Closed Wednesdays and shuts when sold out. Michelin Bib Gourmand.

stalls.where: 大東路 49 號（慈諴宮附近）
stalls.summaryZh: 約 40 年老店，十多種藥材熬湯，湯頭甘甜溫潤、排骨軟嫩，可加滷肉飯或麵線；用餐時段人潮滿。米其林必比登推薦。
stalls.summaryEn: A shop of about 40 years. The broth is simmered with more than a dozen herbs and tastes mellow and slightly sweet, and the ribs are tender. Add braised pork rice or noodles. Packed at mealtimes. Michelin Bib Gourmand.

stalls.summaryZh: 芝麻醬涼麵加了檸檬和榨菜，酸香帶麻辣，夏天特別受歡迎；店面小，傍晚後常要等位。週四公休，連續多年獲必比登推薦。
stalls.summaryEn: Sesame cold noodles with lemon and pickled mustard greens, tangy and spicy. Especially popular in summer. The shop is small, so expect a wait after dusk. Closed Thursdays. A Bib Gourmand pick for several years in a row.

stalls.summaryZh: 蚵仔煎表面煎得焦脆、粉漿不厚，醬汁偏甜；不少老饕說生炒花枝羹比蚵仔煎更值得點。菜單選擇多。
stalls.summaryEn: The oyster omelet is fried crisp on top with a thin batter and a sweetish sauce. Many regulars say the stir-fried squid soup is even better than the omelet. The menu is large.

stalls.summaryZh: 湯頭濃郁微甜帶蒜香，麵線不會煮得太爛，可選大腸、花枝或綜合；麻辣豬血糕也有人推。
stalls.summaryEn: A rich, slightly sweet broth with garlic, and vermicelli that is not overcooked. Choose intestine, squid or mixed. Some also recommend the spicy pig's blood cake.

foodsEn: Fried whole potato with cheese sauce
stalls.summaryZh: 整顆馬鈴薯裹粉炸到外酥，再淋起司醬與配料，份量大適合分食；排隊常態，綜合口味最多人點，也有素食版。
stalls.summaryEn: A whole potato breaded and fried until crisp, then topped with cheese sauce and fillings. Big enough to share. There is usually a line. The mixed flavour is the most popular, and a vegetarian version is available.

stalls.summaryEn: Fried, then brushed with sauce and grilled over charcoal. The cutlet is big and thick with a crisp skin. There is often a line, but it moves fast, usually under 20 minutes.

sources.title: 士林夜市美食推薦（蕃新聞旅遊，2025 更新）

stalls.summaryEn: Sells just one item: pork slices rolled around scallion and garlic sprouts and grilled over charcoal. The sauce is sweet and savoury, and the meat is juicy. A long-time favourite known by word of mouth.
